customers.evidence: Each day, our employees around the world work together for patients – patients are at the center of everything we do.

employees.evidence: We have the brightest people in the industry and believe that their diverse experiences and perspectives help to bring out our best ideas

dei.evidence: We have the brightest people in the industry and believe that their diverse experiences and perspectives help to bring out our best ideas, drive innovation and achieve transformative business results.

environment.evidence: Preservation of natural resources is one of our key commitments.

community.evidence: As global citizens, we work sustainably and responsibly to create a positive impact in the communities where we live and work.

integrity.evidence: We conduct our global business with the utmost integrity and transparency.

innovation.evidence: Passion, innovation, urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity ground our work and unite our community.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, patient-centred framing; patients are placed first, employees and community follow. Mostly third-person 'we' with absolute language ('utmost integrity', 'at the center of everything'). Innovation and shared values are headline items. Shareholder and safety themes are absent; environment appears only once.
